source: Read-only asset source: /Users/nicolas/Documents/github/carmodels (recovered car model corpus). This game ships copied GLBs and never reads the sibling repository at runtime.
notice: Vehicle models are recovered from the named commercial games and are the property of their respective rights holders; used here as local research/showcase assets. Handling presets, physics values, audio and all gameplay tuning are game-specific creations of rust-racer and do not reproduce original vehicle performance data.

adjustments: Imported via Bevy glTF loader; scene normalized (meters, -Z forward, ground contact) through a visual child transform.
Game importer clamps metallic factors to 0 for painted/trim surfaces, keeps baseColor textures, hides MC3 drop-shadow mesh.
Independent rim+tire wheel nodes are re-parented as steerable/spinning wheel visuals.
No geometry edits; original GLB bytes copied verbatim (hash above).
